---
title: "Runway crossings"
description: "How OPDI finds a taxiing aircraft crossing a runway (runway-crossing-entry and runway-crossing-vacated)."
---

## In one sentence

`runway-crossing-entry` and `runway-crossing-vacated` mark when a taxiing
aircraft enters a runway to cross it and when it leaves it on the other side.

## What it needs

- A **runway pass** (see
  [Take-off and landing times](take-off-landing.qmd#runway-pass-method)) with
  reports on the runway itself.
- The ground flag or the altitude of these reports, to tell a crossing on the
  ground from an aircraft flying low over the runway.

## How it is computed

1. Take the reports of the pass that lie on the runway itself (between the two
   thresholds and within half its width of the centre line).
2. The pass is a **crossing** when all of these hold:
   - the aircraft's median ground track is at least 45° away from the
     runway's direction;
   - its ground speed never exceeds 40 kt;
   - the pass lasts at most 120 s;
   - the aircraft is on the ground at the start and the end: less than 15 ft
     above the ground, or flagged on the ground without an altitude
     (airliners send no altitude on the ground).
3. A pass on a runway that the same aircraft takes off from, lands on or turns
   off from in that pass is not a crossing of it. Only the take-offs and
   landings kept after the choice between parallel runways count here (see
   [the runway-pass method](take-off-landing.qmd#runway-pass-method)): a
   reading on a parallel runway that was not kept does not remove a
   crossing.
4. `runway-crossing-entry` is the first report of the crossing and
   `runway-crossing-vacated` the last. Both are received reports.

A pass between 30° and 45° from the runway direction is neither a take-off
or landing nor a crossing, and gives no event.

## Based on

- Developed for OPDI, on the runway passes of the
  [runway-pass method](take-off-landing.qmd#runway-pass-method). A runway
  crossing has no milestone in the [A-CDM Implementation
  Manual](../resources.qmd#ref-acdm-manual).
- Study: [Flight events from ADS-B, version 4](../../papers/flight-events-v4/index.html).

## What is published

Event types `runway-crossing-entry` and `runway-crossing-vacated`, with
position, altitude, `distance_flown_nm` and `time_passed_s`. Their `info` holds
`apt_icao`, `runway`, `runway_bearing_deg`, `traversal_class` (`crossing`),
`align_deg` and `max_gs_kt` (see the
[Data dictionary](../data/dictionary.qmd#info-fields)).

## Use cases

- **Runway crossings per airport and hour**, an input to studies of runway
  safety and of taxi routes.
- **Time spent crossing**: `runway-crossing-vacated` minus
  `runway-crossing-entry`.

## Limitations

Needs ground reception on the runway; a crossing with few reports, or one at
an angle under 45°, is missed. See
[Limitations: runway events](../limitations.qmd#lim-runway).
